meta.description: Mapping from Holland RIASEC types to Colombian CINE F 2013 AC broad fields (campo amplio)
meta.source: Author-curated weighted mapping based on Holland (1997) classical occupational typology and the SNIES CINE F 2013 AC field taxonomy maintained by Colombia's Ministry of Education.
meta.note: Field names match exact values in SNIES program catalog. Weights range 0-1: 1.0 = primary match, 0.5-0.7 = secondary match.
meta.validation_status: Not independently psychometrically validated against external criteria such as O*NET RIASEC interest profiles. The mapping is consistent with classical Holland theory, but a more rigorous derivation would require validation studies that are not currently published.
meta.contribution_invitation: If you have access to empirically derived RIASEC-to-CINE weights (e.g., from O*NET interest profiles cross-walked via SOC-ISCO-CINE), pull requests are welcome. See github.com/affromero/riasec-co.
references: Holland, J. L. (1997). Making vocational choices: A theory of vocational personalities and work environments (3rd ed.). Psychological Assessment Resources. https://archive.org/details/makingvocational0000holl
SNIES — Sistema Nacional de Información de la Educación Superior. https://hecaa.mineducacion.gov.co/consultaspublicas/programas
